front.title: Scientific Constitutional Law: Evidence and Authority Boundaries for Networked Research

abstract.t:
This document proposes Scientific Constitutional Evidence Gates (SCEG), a JSON exchange profile for recording and evaluating whether evidence-bearing research claims may cross a declared governance boundary. It specifies typed evidence states, an explicit transition decision procedure, provenance and policy bindings, and independently verifiable receipts. The design prevents integrity checks, structural conformance, or matching scientific invariants from being silently promoted into scientific truth, independent reproduction, or institutional authority.
The term "constitutional law" denotes internal, machine-checkable governance constraints; this proposal does not create state law, legal rights, institutional authority, scientific certification, or IETF consensus. It is an individual Informational Internet-Draft intended to support interoperable, falsifiable research workflows.
